summary: For a shared Northern Thai meal, Huen Muan Jai is a strong restaurant fit: a Lanna-style garden restaurant with classic regional dishes and a northern appetizer sampler. This registry activity means a restaurant dinner with friends or family, not a ticketed cultural show. Khantoke dinner-and-dance evenings are a separate, more staged option.
whyGo: Order several dishes for the table and compare chilli dips, sai ua sausage, hang lay curry, laab and seasonal vegetables instead of focusing on one dish.
Michelin describes a garden setting with indoor and outdoor tables and recommends the northern appetizer sampler; it lists Huen Muan Jai as a Bib Gourmand restaurant.
The meal is flexible: choose dishes and pace rather than following a fixed performance schedule.
bestFor: Two or more diners who want to sample several Northern Thai dishes together.
Travelers seeking a local restaurant meal in a relaxed garden setting.
skipIf: You want folk dance and music included; book a dedicated khantoke dinner show instead.
You need guaranteed vegan, halal, allergy-safe or wheelchair-accessible arrangements; confirm directly first.
duration: Allow 60–90 minutes for dinner (planning estimate); allow extra time at peak periods.
cost: Michelin lists the restaurant in the ฿ price tier. Wongnai currently shows a northern appetizer sampler at ฿290, khao niao at ฿20, and sample dishes such as sai ua and laab at about ฿100 each. Prices can change; budget roughly ฿200–400 per person for a shared meal before drinks (planning estimate).
hours: Michelin currently lists Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; Wednesday closed. Verify before travelling, especially during holidays.
bestTime: For dinner, arrive near the 17:00 reopening or reserve/confirm a later table directly. December is a popular travel period; allow for queues and road traffic.
gettingThere: Huen Muan Jai is at 24 Ratchaphruek Road, Chang Phueak, north-west of the old city. Use a taxi, ride-hail or songthaew and show the address; allow around 10–20 minutes from the old city by road as a traffic-dependent estimate. Michelin lists a car park.
booking: Michelin says the restaurant manages its own bookings and lists +66 53 404 998. Call to confirm a dinner table, current hours, group seating and the menu. The Michelin booking link is informational; reservations are not available through Michelin itself.
accessibility: Michelin lists indoor air conditioning, garden/outdoor dining and parking, but does not document step-free access, accessible toilets or wheelchair routes. Contact the restaurant to discuss mobility needs and request indoor seating if useful; availability is unconfirmed.
practicalTips: Share a northern appetizer sampler, then add a few dishes such as hang lay, sai ua, laab and vegetables with sticky rice; check the current menu before choosing.
Expect chilli and strong herbs in some dishes. Ask staff about spice and ingredients, but do not assume every dish can be adjusted.

For a dance-and-music programme, Old Chiangmai Cultural Center currently advertises a separate khantoke dinner show, around 18:30–20:30 and from ฿690; confirm details and dietary suitability with the operator.
decemberNotes: Michelin's weekly hours are current listings, not a guarantee for December 2026. No special year-end schedule was verified. Confirm opening, table availability, menu and holiday hours directly near your date; the separate khantoke show's current schedule and prices are also subject to change.
uncertainties: December 2026 opening hours, prices, menu availability and reservation availability are not confirmed.
Dietary substitutions, allergen controls, cross-contact and halal or vegan preparation are undocumented; verify directly.
Step-free access, wheelchair route and accessible toilet details are not published.
The ฿200–400 per-person dinner budget is a planning estimate based on listed sample prices, not a fixed set menu.
